name: tinkerclaw-core
description: The TinkerClaw moral code (ethical rules, objectives, starter kit) at session start and after compaction; a harness card telling plain Claude Code and the TinkerClaw chat worker which side they are on and what they share, plus the workspace persona files on the Claude Code side; saved-recipe hints per prompt in plain Claude Code; and a PreToolUse guard that turns a background Fractal reflection's sends, deletes, publishes, spends and restarts into proposals (armed only on the workers the Tinker bridge starts for Fractal sessions)
